name: redeem-code-bot
description: Polling Telegram bot for referral points and redeem code withdrawals.

BOT_USERNAME.description: Optional. If empty, the bot fetches its username from Telegram on startup.

ADMIN_IDS.description: Comma-separated Telegram user IDs allowed to use admin commands.

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL URL. postgres:// and postgresql:// URLs are accepted and normalized to asyncpg.

REQUIRED_CHANNEL_IDS.description: Comma-separated required channel usernames or numeric IDs.

REFERRAL_REWARD_POINTS.description: Points awarded after a referred user passes verification.

WITHDRAW_COST_POINTS.description: Minimum points required to request a redeem code.

SUPPORT_STARS_AMOUNT.description: Telegram Stars amount for the Support Developer invoice.
